title: Linux Command #54 – lsattr (Linux OS)
excerpt: Learn the Linux lsattr command: inspect immutable, append-only, and other filesystem attributes; read lsattr output; distinguish attributes from ACLs and permissions; and troubleshoot files that will not change or delete.
